subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit-log retention, pen-test evidence and SLO exceptions
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@bluebank.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluebank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit-log retention, pen-test evidence and SLO exceptions

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned. High-level notes: 

- Primary pain: inconsistent audit logs across environments + strict 7-year retention policy for archived ledger traces. BlueBank needs demonstrable chain-of-custody for request-level logs.
- Security goals: SOC 2 evidence for access controls and log retention; pen-test window (we discussed Q4) with vendor-provided findings; DPA language alignment around subprocessing and retention.
- SLO concern: you flagged a 99.99% availability target for critical payment routes and an exception process for maintenance windows.

Action items I captured (owner / ETA):
1) Hannah — share a compact evidence intake checklist and scope matrix (attached) so your infosec can map artifacts quickly — EOD Mon 9/14.
2) Ben — provide a minimal audit-log config snippet and sample retention export (for your security team) — Tue 9/15.
3) Maya/Devon — confirm whether retention is 7 years for all logs or tiered (7y for transaction, 1y for app debug) and confirm preferred pen-test vendor window — by Fri 9/18.
4) Irene — prep DPA redline highlights and call out any SLO exception language we should surface to legal — Tue 9/15.

Attachments: soc2-scope-matrix.xlsx (scope by control + artifact owner), audit-log-config-snippet.txt, pen-test-questionnaire-responses.pdf (early answers).

If any of this is off, please correct — otherwise I’ll kick off the items above and loop back after Ben’s sample.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0198 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

---
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@bluebank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluebank.com>, security@bluebank.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 17:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit-log retention, pen-test evidence and SLO exceptions

Hannah — thanks for the thorough summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention: 7 years for transaction-level audit trails (legal requirement). App debug and ephemeral traces can be archived for 1 year.
- Pen test: preferred window is Nov 8–12 (internal blackout Nov 1–5) — vendor TBD but we'll share the name by 9/18.
- SLO exception process: we need a documented emergency maintenance SLA that includes notification timelines and rollback commitments.

We'll review the attachments; Ben's audit-log sample will be helpful. For DPA redlines — our counsel will request a subprocessor list and a data deletion certification process (both noted).

Maya Patel
Head of Information Security, BlueBank
maya.patel@bluebank.com | +1 617-555-0987

On a logistics note, can we get an exported example of a 7-year retention bucket and a read-only delivery mechanism (S3 presigned URL or secure download) so our compliance team can verify chain-of-custody?

Best,
Maya
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@bluebank.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluebank.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit-log retention, pen-test evidence and SLO exceptions

Maya — attaching the requested samples. Quick notes: 

- audit-log-config-snippet.txt (attached) shows our event schema (timestamp, request_id, actor_id, operation, model_id, shard, checksum) and an example lifecycle that writes to hot store then to immutable cold archive.
- For the 7-year export: we can produce a signed, time-stamped tarball of the transaction-level logs and deliver via a presigned S3 URL with MFA-delete enabled; the export will include SHA256 checksums and a manifest for chain-of-custody.
- Pen-test scope: we recommend a gray-box engagement (no production write injection) and we’ll provide a sandbox dataset and credentials for initial vendor validation; full production window Nov 8–12 is acceptable on our side if we coordinate maintenance blackout windows.

Actioning: Hannah/Irene — I’ve put the artifacts in the shared Drive folder (link below). I’ll follow up with the exact S3 export delivery cadence and a sample manifest by Tue 9/15.

Attachments: audit-log-config-snippet.txt, pen-test-questionnaire-responses.pdf

Ben Carter
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0222

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cScopeDocs
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/Deal/BB-4721

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@bluebank.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@bluebank.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit-log retention, pen-test evidence and SLO exceptions

Thanks everyone — short legal/ops follow-up: 

- DPA: I’ll circulate a redline summary by Tue 9/15 highlighting subprocessor disclosure, retention clauses, and a proposed deletion attestation cadence. If BlueBank counsel has a preferred clause set, please send it to me directly (irene.choi@redwood.com).
- SLO exceptions: we can include an emergency maintenance appendix. Proposed text will include notification 24 hours prior for planned maintenance and a 4-hour maximum initial rollback window for critical payment routes; if deviate, we’ll require SLA credits. Please flag if that’s unacceptable.
- Next sync: propose a 30-minute alignment call Wed 9/16 10:00 AM PT to review artifacts and DPA redlines.

I’ll mark the Drive folder as read-only for external reviewers and share the S3 export process doc once Ben posts the sample manifest.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Compliance Solutions | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
